rows.en:
(Hmm, I just can't solve this problem.
It's already evening, too. I've gotta do something...)

If it isn't \p.
Studying of your own accord? Commendable,
very commendable.

Oh, Klan-senpai...
Well, the thing is, I can't solve this one problem,
and I've been stuck on it...

Hmm, this problem, is it?
Well, you see...

I see... I finally get it.
Thank you, Klan-senpai!

Mm.
So you don't forget what I taught you today,
go home and review it thoroughly.
(Klan-senpai's smarter than she looks.)
(...If I said that, she'd get mad at me, though.)

(Hmm, I just can't solve this problem.
It's already evening, too. I've gotta do something...)
(Klan-senpai's smarter than she looks.)
(Let's see... my next classroom is......)
Yo, \p.
Oh, Klan-senpai, hello!

Mm, a lively greeting. Very good.
So, have you gotten used to Mihoshi Academy?
Yes, thanks to you, I've gotten pretty used to it.
I see. Good to hear.

But don't let your guard down because of it.
Right when you start getting used to things
is when you're most likely to slip up.
Yes. Excuse me, then.
rows.notes: Followed by c07740 'Mm. See you around.'

rows.en:
(It still feels weird when Klan-senpai
treats me like she's the older one...)
rows.notes: She is older; the joke is her childlike micronized look.

rows.en:
(It still feels weird when Klan-senpai
treats me like she's the older one...)
(What should I buy in the Shibuya Area today...?)
(Wait, is that Klan-senpai?)

Oh, if it isn't \p.
What are you doing in a place like this?

I was thinking of doing a little shopping...
What about you, Klan-senpai?

I came to buy some clothes.
I heard the new line was in, so I came to check it out.
Huh~ So you're surprisingly girly too, Klan-senpai.

Hm? \p...
Did you just say something?
N-No... It's nothing......

Honestly, you fool.
You won't find many maidens as pure-hearted
and lovely as me.
Mm, as long as you understand.
Well, enjoy your shopping. See you.

(Phew~ Klan-senpai almost chewed me out
big time...)

(From now on I'd better be careful
not to blurt out anything unnecessary...)
(What should I buy in the Shibuya Area today...?)

(Phew~ Klan-senpai almost chewed me out
big time...)

(Maybe I'll have Galaxy Ramen
at Nyan-Nyan for lunch today.)
rows.notes: Shared by the male, female and single variants of nml_kln_019.

rows.en:
(Wait, the person coming out of the shop...
that's Klan-senpai, right?)

Oh, if it isn't \p.
Here for some Galaxy Ramen at Nyan-Nyan?
Yes, that's exactly it.

Mm, Nyan-Nyan's Galaxy Ramen is superb.
I must keep practicing until I can make noodles
like that myself.
Huh! You can make noodles by hand, Klan-senpai?

I do it now and then when I'm macronized.
If I get the chance, I'll treat you to some.
I'll look forward to it.

(Klan-senpai can make noodles by hand...
That kind of surprised me...)

(Wait, the person coming out of the shop...
that's Klan-senpai, right?)

(Klan-senpai can make noodles by hand...
That kind of surprised me...)

Haha, don't get so cranky, Klan.
Oh, wait, are you low on calcium? Is that why
your height and your chest are both so small?
rows.notes: Michel to Klan. karikari (irritable) leads into the calcium joke.

rows.en: Grr! What did you say, Michel!!

(Klan-senpai and Michel fighting again...
Come to think of it, what's the deal with those two?)

Klan-senpai, you and Michel get along well,
but what exactly is your relationship?

Wh-Where on earth do you see Michel and me
getting along...

I often see you two playfully
messing around together...

That's not messing around!
Michel is just teasing me, that's all!
Is that so?

It is!
Besides, Michel and I are just childhood friends.

So as his senior, I have no choice
but to look after him!

(If anything, it looks more like Michel's
the one looking after Klan-senpai...)
Do you understand!?

(Klan-senpai doesn't have to deny it that hard...
Oh, maybe she's just embarrassed?)

(Klan-senpai and Michel-kun fighting again...
Come to think of it, what's the deal with those two?)

Klan-senpai, you and Michel-kun get along well,
but what exactly is your relationship?

(If anything, it looks more like Michel-kun's
the one looking after Klan-senpai...)

(Klan-senpai doesn't have to deny it that hard...
Oh, maybe she's just embarrassed?)
